thesis: The agent winners will not be those with the best answers, but those that can prove outcomes, detect failure, and safely retry without human supervision.
doctrine: Every autonomous action must declare a measurable success condition, emit a runtime receipt, and enter a bounded retry or escalation path when verification fails.
proof_artifact: Ship a reusable execution-quality gate that wraps Shadow jobs with expected outcomes, receipt validation, failure classification, bounded retries, and revenue-impact metrics.
proof_next_action: Inspect the latest research_signal_candidates and Shadow job runner, then add one failing-first test plus a verifier that rejects any completed job lacking a timestamped outcome receipt.
public_angle: Your AI agent does not need another prompt. It needs a definition of done, proof that the work happened, and permission to retry safely when it did not.
buyer_offer: Sell a fixed-price Agent Reliability Audit that instruments a prospect's highest-value AI workflow with outcome checks, retry gates, and an evidence dashboard, then upsell ongoing monitoring toward $500/month MRR.
